body: Vocal Remover using Deep Neural Networks
plain_description: **Separate songs into vocal and instrumental tracks.** Run it on a computer with a CPU or GPU. You can also train a model on your own audio dataset.
technical_description: A Python deep-learning tool that separates an input audio file into instrumental and vocal WAV tracks. It supports CPU and GPU inference, optional test-time augmentation and postprocessing, and training on a user-provided dataset. Installation requires PyTorch and the packages in requirements.txt.
title: vocal-remover
